task: DS Error, H_res Routing, and Product Stability Analysis

mHC default.notes: H_res logits receive zero gradients so stay at initialization. Sinkhorn range ~160 (extremely high) but DS error is zero because H_res_logits remain uniform (all-zeros init). No learned routing.

Cap-init.notes: H_res logits receive negligible gradients (~1e-15 to 1e-21). Sinkhorn range ~30 (better conditioned). DS error zero because logits barely move from initialization. Tiny non-zero entropy from lower tau denominator. No meaningful learned routing.

RRCS (r_cap=2.0).notes: RRCS enables gradient flow into H_res_logits (~1e-5 grad norms). Sinkhorn range grows to ~162 but is capped to r_cap=2.0 before iterations. DS errors are small but non-zero (~4e-7 mean), confirming the range-capped inputs still produce near-DS outputs. Entropy ~0.93 indicates meaningful learned routing patterns that are neither purely permutation-like nor purely uniform. Product stability is excellent (9e-8 at depth 96).
